cues.text: At school, two women teachers stand talking. You are nearby, your bag over your shoulder.
You turn to go, and your phone slips out of your pocket and falls open on the floor. Ms. Toriumi turns toward you.
Ms. Toriumi walks over, picks up your phone and looks at its screen.
Ms. Toriumi clutches her head in both hands and doubles over, your phone still in her hand.
Mrs. Terauchi runs off to fetch help.
